feature.summary: Add psc init starter-project scaffolding and install documentation.
details: psc init [dir] creates a Software Profile starter project.
The starter contains README.md, .gitignore, package.json, proofscript.config.json, and src/Main.ps.
The generated program checks and builds to TypeScript through the existing PSC-1 software-profile path.
Non-empty target directories are rejected unless --force is passed.

notes: In final clean extract, the grouped npm verify wrapper exceeded the session timeout after starting the examples gate; profile consistency, executable examples, psc adapter/init, and psc init/check/build-ts/compile were rerun as bounded component gates and passed.
